name: Shard of a Felhound

angles.text: Binding the essence of a felhound into a ruby demands direct command over demonic spirits.

faq.answer: The ruby draws out and imprisons the spirit of a felhound in Desolace when turned upon the beast.
faq.q: What is the Felhas Ruby used for?

faq.answer: Menara Voidrender waits in the Barrens.
Prowling felhounds roam the wastes of Desolace.
Return both the ruby and the imprisoned demonic essence to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
faq.q: Who seeks the imprisoned felhound spirit?

sections.body: Menara Voidrender sends you west into the wastes of Desolace to trap a demon. Armed with a Felhas Ruby, you must bind the spirit of a living felhound before it tears free. Bringing the captive essence back to the Barrens will place its feral strength in the warlock's hands.
sections.title: Trapping the Beast

summary: Menara Voidrender in the Barrens requires the imprisoned essence of a living demon. You carry the Felhas Ruby westward to Desolace to bind the spirit of a roaming felhound.
attribution: In-game quest text: Shard of a Felhound
